import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C = new long[777][777];
    static int r, c;
    static long total;
    static long best = (long) 1e18, best_z = -1;

    public static void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
            if (diff < best) {
                best = diff;
                best_z = x;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    public static long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long state = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        Map<Long, Long> mp = new HashMap<>();
        if (mp.containsKey(state)) return mp.get(state);
        long res = 0;
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best) {
            return res = 0;
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return res = C[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return res = 0;
        }
        res = 0;
        char c = s[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        mp.put(state, res);
        return res;
    }

    static char[] s = new char[12345];
    static int[] cntA = new int[12345];
    static int[] cntB = new int[12345];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        r = scanner.nextInt();
        c = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
        total = C[r + c][r] * C[r + c][r];
        {
            long x = 0, y = 0;
            int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
            while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
                if (x > y) {
                    long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
                    long sum2 = C[v2][r];
                    y += cur1 * sum2;
                    v1--;
                } else {
                    long sum1 = C[v1][r];
                    long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                    x += sum1 * cur2;
                    v2--;
                }
            }
            best = Math.abs(x - y);
        }
        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        scanner.next();
        cntA[0] = cntB[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s[i] == 'A');
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s[i] == 'B');
        }
        long ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
